body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.62 (naive base rate 0.55) that: Target Q4 2026 comparable sales growth is ≥+3.0%. Evidence: 8-K 18-Nov-2026 (Q3 2026): net sales +7.1%, comparable sales +5.6% (traffic +5.0%; stores +4.6%, digital +9.8%); November month-to-date 'in line with the Company's guidance… accelerating from October'. FY2026 guide raised: net sales growth ~6% (+1 pt), operating margin ~6.2% incl. ~1.1 pt tariff-refund benefit, EPS $10.65–11.40. Q4 2025 is an easy compare (Target's comps were negative through 2025). Reasoning: Traffic-led comps and an easy compare favour ≥3%; risks are a weaker holiday consumer (rate hikes, inflation) and the 53rd/calendar shift noise. Resolution: YES if Target's reported Q4 2026 comparable sales change (Q4 earnings release) ≥ +3.0%. Source: Target Q4 2026 earnings 8-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 27419). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: A retailer comping +5–6% with traffic leading sustains ≥3% the next quarter roughly 55% of the time.
data.resolution_rule: YES if Target's reported Q4 2026 comparable sales change (Q4 earnings release) ≥ +3.0%.

title: Paper call: Target Q4 2026 comparable sales growth is ≥+3.0%
